title: Paperwork Step for Appraisal Papers Travelling with a Piece
content:
# Service Training Note: The Paperwork Step for Appraisal Papers Travelling with a Piece

## The rule the desk applies

Where papers from the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services travel with a piece sent back insured from the bench of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, a step is added to the shipping rate. It is read from the appraisal engagement standing on that piece: where it stands, and, where its report has been delivered, whether that report is still current.

1. Where an appraisal engagement on the piece has been delivered and its report is still current at the handling date, the report paperwork step of 12 percent is added.
2. Where an appraisal engagement on the piece is still being examined or drafted, the open engagement step of 6 percent is added.
3. In any other case no step is added on this ground.

## Questions answered

**Which engagements fall under clause 2?** Those standing in examination and those whose report has been drafted but not yet gone out.

**What of an engagement delivered whose report has run out?** Clause 1 asks for a report still current at the handling date; where the report has run out, clause 3 answers and no step is added on this ground.

**Does a cancelled engagement carry a step?** No: it falls under neither of the first two clauses.

**Hypothetical readings.** A piece whose appraisal engagement has been delivered with a report current for another 200 days carries 12 percent. A piece whose engagement stands in examination carries 6 percent; one whose report stands drafted carries 6 percent. A piece whose delivered report ran out last month carries no step on this ground, and a piece with no engagement at all carries none either.
